features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalized age to ensure equal weighting in distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents the age feature from dominating Euclidean distance computations due to its larger raw scale.

features.name: duration_log_norm
features.description: Log-normalized call duration scaled to approximately [0, 1] to prevent large outliers from skewing neighborhood geometry.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the long tail of call durations, allowing KNN to find more meaningful local neighborhoods.

features.name: campaign_penalty
features.description: Clipped and scaled number of contacts during this campaign to represent persistence without distorting distance metrics.
features.expected_model_benefit: Limits the spatial impact of extreme campaign contact counts, improving the robustness of distance measurements.

features.name: pdays_contacted_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator of previous contact, creating a distinct spatial separation between new and returning individuals.
features.expected_model_benefit: Forces a structural split in the feature space, ensuring KNN groups previously contacted individuals together.

features.name: economic_stress_index
features.description: Composite standardized metric of employment variation and consumer confidence, aligning economic factors into a single dimension.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces dimensionality of correlated economic indicators, providing a cleaner signal for distance calculations.

features.name: euribor_employment_dist
features.description: Euclidean distance to the dataset mean for euribor rate and number of employees, capturing macroeconomic deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a radial feature representing how far the current economic climate is from the historical average.

features.name: financial_vulnerability_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of financial risk based on job type, marital status, education, default history, housing, and personal loans.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a dense, meaningful scalar that groups individuals with similar financial profiles closer together in the feature space.

features.name: contact_seasonality_similarity
features.description: Semantic similarity score comparing the month and day of the week to typical high-activity periods.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms cyclical categorical time variables into a continuous similarity metric suitable for Euclidean distance.

features.name: previous_engagement_strength
features.description: Weighted sum of previous contacts based on the outcome of the previous campaign, enhancing the proximity of highly engaged individuals.
features.expected_model_benefit: Differentiates the quality of past interactions, allowing KNN to distinguish between successful and unsuccessful historical engagements.

features.name: age_economic_prototype_dist
features.description: Distance to a specific unsupervised prototype (young age, low employment variation rate) to create a radial basis feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Introduces non-linear spatial relationships by measuring proximity to a specific demographic-economic anchor point.

features.name: socioeconomic_stability_index
features.description: Semantic evaluation of overall stability derived from demographic and economic indicators.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple weak signals into a strong, continuous dimension that improves neighborhood homogeneity.

features.name: recent_activity_density
features.description: Non-linear combination of recency (pdays) and frequency (previous) of contacts, mapping highly active individuals closer together.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a dense cluster of recently and frequently contacted individuals, improving local density estimation for KNN.
